title: The fixed scalar adjoint and native derived scalar counit
statement: Let A,B be commutative rings in Type (u+1), phi:A→B a unital homomorphism and T a scheme in universe u. Let E be ordinary small-etale sheaf scalar extension. Assume E preserves quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes. For the fixed scalar adjoint S and its actual cochain representative r [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations], there exists a natural isomorphism e:S≅LE to the native total left derived functor such that for every cochain complex P, r(P) is e at Q(P) followed by the native left-derived cochain counit. No flatness of B over A or boundedness of P is required.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 07A4, native derived adjunction and cochain counit; extracted from the scalar monoidality argument.

proof.text: Ordinary scalar extension E is left adjoint to exact restriction U. Derive this adjunction and identify the right derived restriction with its exact mapDerivedCategory. The fixed scalar adjunction and this native derived adjunction have the same right functor, so leftAdjointUniq gives e. Apply the adopted-source Adjunction.leftDerivedCochainCounit identity. Unfold scalarExtensionRepresentative and use mapComplex_unit_formula to identify its cochain unit expression with the adjunction unit on cochain complexes. The resulting equation is exactly r(P)=e(QP);cochainCounit(P).

theorem scalarExtension_derivedComparison
    (A B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B) (T : Scheme.{u})
    [(ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalars φ T).PreservesKFlatQuasiIso] :
    ∃ e : scalarExtension φ T ≅ (ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalars φ T).leftDerivedFunctor,
      ∀ P, scalarExtensionRepresentative φ T P =
        e.hom.app (_root_.DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          (ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalars φ T).rightExact_cochainCounit P
